0022600186.text: The Clippers, now 1-6 with a six-game losing streak, host the 2-5 Miami Heat, who have lost their last game. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out for the Clippers, while Derrick Jones Jr. (knee soreness) and Rui Hachimura (quadriceps bruise) are day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Clippers lost 0-2, including a 140-123 loss in Miami on December 1, 2025.
